hierarchy.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-charcoal
hierarchy.labels: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.15em] font-semibold text-ocean-blue/70

typography.instructions: Use Playfair Display for all headings (H1-H4) to evoke premium, traditional authenticity. Use Outfit for body, buttons, UI elements (price, weights) for crisp modern app-like legibility. Do NOT use Inter or standard sans fonts.

primary_brand.description: Deep ocean blue. Use for primary text in badges, dark footer backgrounds, header announcement bar, and active states.

accent.description: Warm earthy sunset orange. Use for primary CTAs ('Buy Now', 'Add to Cart'), notification dots, discount badges, and selective hover states.

background.description: Base is Off-white/Cream for natural authenticity. Surface is Pure White for high-contrast product cards. Sand for secondary sections (Trust cards, combos).

header.announcement_bar: bg-[#1A3A5C] text-[#F9F8F6] text-sm py-2 text-center font-outfit
header.main_nav: Sticky at top with z-50. Surface must be Glassmorphism (NO fully transparent headers). Must include Brand Logo, Desktop Links, Search, User, Cart.
header.mobile_bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white border-t border-sand pb-safe pt-2 flex justify-around shadow-[0_-10px_20px_rgb(0,0,0,0.03)]. Icons: Home, Shop, Search, Wishlist, Cart.

product_card.structure: Surface: white, shadow-soft, rounded-2xl overflow-hidden group hover:shadow-elevated transition-all duration-300.
product_card.image: aspect-square object-cover w-full group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500
product_card.title: font-playfair text-lg font-semibold truncate
product_card.weight_selector: flex gap-2 mt-3 text-sm font-outfit border border-sand rounded-lg p-1
product_card.ctas: w-full mt-4 bg-[#F9F8F6] text-[#1A3A5C] hover:bg-[#D96E3E] hover:text-white rounded-full py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors

trust_cards.style: bg-[#EFECE5] rounded-2xl p-6 flex flex-col items-center text-center gap-3

hero_section.content: Left-aligned, high emotional impact. H1 font-playfair, large whitespace. Avoid centering.

layouts_and_grids.general: Generous spacing. Use py-20 to py-32 for sections. Container max-width: 1440px.
layouts_and_grids.product_grid: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6 lg:gap-8
layouts_and_grids.bento_combos: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Hero combo spans col-span-12 md:col-span-8, secondary spans col-span-12 md:col-span-4.

motion.scrolling: Implement smooth scrolling (Lenis) for premium feel.
motion.hover_states: Buttons use transform translateY(-2px). Images scale 105%.
motion.page_load: Fade up text layers using Framer Motion with stagger.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on cream/sand background meets APCA contrast guidelines.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based.

media_and_icons.images_rule: Large, high-quality, border-radius applied to avoid sharp blocks unless full screen. Max-height 80vh on mobile to prevent blocking scroll.

image_urls.description: Sunset over ocean beach, perfect for hero section conveying coastal origins.
Cooked shrimps on a blue ceramic plate. Perfect for showcasing the cooked end-result in 'Combo' or 'Best Seller' thumbnails.
Rich orange sauce salmon, shows premium cooked output.
Dried fish stack. Good for authentic coastal sourcing background or category headers.
Inside traditional stall. Use for 'Authentic shutki' or 'Sourcing' section.

instructions_to_main_agent.stack: React.js (use .js files, NOT .tsx), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Framer Motion.
implementation_steps: 2. Configure tailwind.config.js with provided color hexes, custom fonts (Playfair Display, Outfit).
3. Build Custom Product Card Component matching exact design specs (no standard Shadcn card for products).
4. Implement Sticky Header with Glassmorphism and Mobile Bottom Nav (z-50).
5. Implement Floating WhatsApp button above bottom nav on mobile.
6. Build Homepage layout incorporating Hero, Category Scroll, Budget Grid, Bestsellers Carousel, Combos, Trust sections.
7. Scaffold PDP (Product Detail Page) with tabs and pin code checker.
8. All CTAs and interactive items must include data-testid.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_usage: Use Shadcn strictly for complex interactive elements (Select, Accordion, Tabs for PDP, Carousel, Dialog for quick view). Do NOT use Shadcn Card for product displays, build raw HTML/Tailwind for artful control.
strict_rules: DO NOT add .App { text-align: center; } in any CSS.
NEVER use generic fonts for Headings. Use Playfair Display.
NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or dropdowns. Use the specified Glassmorphism utility.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
